name: smwgraphics-tecmo-cup-soccer-game-font
title: Tecmo Cup: Soccer Game - Font
description:
The font from the NES game Tecmo Cup: Soccer Game (also known as Captain Tsubasa in Japan, and as Tecmo Cup: Football Game in Europe).

Note: The number sign/hashtag and the parentheses were replaced with a colon, a plus sign and mid-line ellipsis, as that game didn't include the replaced characters.
